basic_info.description: Fully Detached building! Wonderful quintessential Spacious 2bd 1.5ba Victorian Condo Circa 1885 on the Wiggle in a two unit building.Full floor flat, Freshly painted and Refinished hardwood floors with high ceilings throughout.Generous bedrooms, primary with custom built in armoire and decorative marble fireplace. Second bedroom gets amazing natural light and also has decorative fireplace. The living room is washed with morning sunshine and the kitchen, Dining area and Deck are radiant with afternoon sun.The Large spacious kitchen and Dining area with its stunning maple flooring, Island with granite countertop and gas cooktop plus recessed lighting is quite striking. The Perfect hangout space. The island is ideal for entertaining and every day life.  Beautiful wainscoting trim work preserved thoughout, updated bathrooms. Double french glassed doors lead to the exclusive use deck for those sunny afternoons.       Exclusive use Laundry located in the garage area, Designated storage in the garage area. Independent 1 car garage parking for small to medium sized vehicle. Close to so many shops and parks.Lower Haight only 1/2 a block away, Harvey Milk Recreational Art Center, Duboce Playground and dog park one block away, this is a wonderful neighborhood to call home. Low HOA dues $45
